page_title: AUG 1-2 DAR | Augsburg v Darmstadt 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+5' Substitution. Matthias Bader makes way for Thomas Poppler Isherwood (Darmstadt).
90+4' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+3' Augsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
86' 1 - 2 Goal! Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:2.
82' Torsten Lieberknecht prepares a substitution. Tobias Kempe is replaced by Clemens Riedel (Darmstadt).
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) comes onto the pitch so that Tim Skarke can be given a rest.
81' Darmstadt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
78' The linesman points to the corner flag, Augsburg are going to take it.
78' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
77' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the left post and wastes a promising chance!
76' Marcel Schuhen (Darmstadt) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
75' Here comes a substitution. Irvin Cardona (Augsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Patric Pfeiffer.
75' Marcel Schuhen (Darmstadt) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
74' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) gets a yellow card.
71' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to make a change. Andreas Muller (Darmstadt) replaces Marvin Mehlem.
71' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to substitute Luca Pfeiffer and he is replaced by Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt).
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Tim Breithaupt will be replaced by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg).
70' 0 - 2 Goal! Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Finn Dahmen to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
70' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) is going to take the penalty!
69' Arne Maier (Augsburg) tackles a bit over-zealously and Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul. It's a penalty! Darmstadt have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
66' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
66' Sven Michel (Augsburg) has tested the patience of referee Deniz Aytekin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
65' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
62' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
59' Yellow card. Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
58' We are about to witness a subsitution. Sven Michel (Augsburg) for Iago.
58' Here is a change. Phillip Tietz is going off and Enrico Maassen gives the last tactical orders to Arne Maier (Augsburg).
58' Robert Gumny goes off the pitch and Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) comes on.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
54' Flag up against Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
52' 0 - 1 Goal! Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 0:1.
52' It should have been a goal! Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
50' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle as Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Finn Dahmen inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' A player from Darmstadt commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
41' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the left post.
39' Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
38' Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
36' Now Darmstadt have a corner.
36' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) whips in the resulting free kick but one of the defenders heads the ball to safety.
35' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Darmstadt out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
35' What was Robert Gumny (Augsburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
33' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
31' The ball is out of play. Darmstadt win a corner kick.
31' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
28' The referee blows his whistle, Darmstadt are awarded a corner kick.
23' Augsburg will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
19' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
18' Augsburg are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
18' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) commits a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for an infringement.
13' Darmstadt are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
10' Augsburg are ruled offside.
8' Iago (Augsburg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
3' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) commits a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul. Augsburg get a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
Augsburg will kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
